name: menu-price-board
title: Menu Price Board
description: A clean menu board: the title rises through a mask, then each item slides in with its dotted leader and its price, a short note appears and the shop details rise at the bottom. White page, black type, one accent on the note and the order button. Items come from one variable, one per line as "Name|Price".
useWhen: A food or drink menu, a service price list or a class schedule with prices.
Three to eight short lines that should be read one by one.
avoidWhen: A single product with an old and a new price: use price-drop.
More than eight items: split them over several boards.
Long descriptions per item: the rows are made for a name, a price and a few words.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Kicker
variables.description: Small muted line above the title.

variables.label: Items
variables.description: One item per line, "Name|Price" or "Name|Price|Short note". Up to 8 lines.

variables.label: Note
variables.description: Short italic note in the accent colour, top right. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Footer name

variables.label: Footer line
